title: Passing words
description: Two strips of expressive type move in opposite directions.
useCase: Introduce a short set of themes on an editorial or campaign page.
interaction: Pause the movement or hover the strips
reducedMotion: Both rows become static wrapping text; decorative duplicates are removed.
limitations: Use for supplemental copy. Continuous movement needs its pause control; repeated groups are hidden from assistive technology.
look: Pale sage-green field with two full-width rows of dark olive uppercase type, tight sans-serif above italic serif, words divided by pale asterisks.
motion: Two rows of repeated word groups scroll horizontally at constant linear speed in opposite directions, looping every 30 s; hovering with a fine pointer or the pause button stops them.
adapt: Travel is the `mg-marquee-travel` keyframe (`translateX(calc(-100% - 24px))`, 30 s linear) on three `mg-marquee-group` copies per row, reversed by `mg-marquee-reverse`; keep the 24px gap in sync with the keyframe. Replace the `rows` word arrays.
